verdict.rationale: A single community anecdote describes using Claude Design with PenPot 'via its MCP' to build reusable components, implying the product can consume an external MCP server's tools, but there is no first-party documentation or further detail on generic MCP-server plug-in support. Missing for 10: official docs describing MCP server configuration, list of supported servers, and independent corroboration beyond one anecdote.
